title: Evaluation of the electronic, optical, thermoelectrical and magnetic properties of manganite perovskites via DFT calculations and critical exponent analysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,22672-22686
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01703G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Line Karoui, Ala Eddin Mabrouki, Taoufik Mnasri, Anna Bajorek, Mourad Smari
DFT calculations reveal the intrinsic electronic, thermoelectrical and optical properties of La0.8Sr0.2Mn0.8Co0.2O3, while experimental investigations highlight the influence of the gelation temperature on its magnetic critical behaviour.
